data.notes: November 2026 is currently anchored by UNTOLD Dubai and a run of large-scale Pacha ICONS electronic events, with major arena and opera concerts also confirmed.

events.title: UNTOLD Dubai 2026
events.summary: UNTOLD Dubai returns for four days and nights at Dubai Parks and Resorts. The official site confirms the 5–8 November 2026 dates, with 2026 artist announcements still to come.

events.title: ANOTR | Pacha ICONS
events.summary: ANOTR headline Pacha ICONS at FIVE LUXE JBR, with DiOSA and Fabrice also listed on the official lineup. The official Pacha ICONS page confirms Friday, November 13, 2026.

events.title: Marco Carola presents Music On | Pacha ICONS
events.summary: Music On returns to Dubai for the season-closing date of its Pacha ICONS series. Marco Carola b2b Chris Stussy headline, joined by Ilario Alicante and DA VID.

events.title: Anuv Jain Live at Expo City Dubai
events.venueName: Dubai Millennium Amphitheatre, Expo City Dubai
events.summary: Anuv Jain brings his Dastakhat world tour to Expo City Dubai. Platinumlist confirms the concert for Friday, 20 November 2026 at Dubai Millennium Amphitheatre.

events.title: Keinemusik | Pacha ICONS
events.summary: Keinemusik bring &ME, Rampa and Adam Port to Bab Al Shams Arena for a Pacha ICONS desert show. The official event page confirms Saturday, November 21, 2026.

events.title: Hiba Tawaji & Ibrahim Maalouf – À La Française
events.summary: Vocalist Hiba Tawaji and trumpeter-composer Ibrahim Maalouf perform À La Française at Dubai Opera. Dubai Opera confirms the one-night performance on 27 November 2026, presented by Live Nation.

events.title: Atif Aslam 2026 in Dubai
events.summary: Atif Aslam returns to Coca-Cola Arena for a large-scale Dubai concert. Platinumlist confirms the event for Friday, 27 November 2026.

events.title: URJA – Divine Energy
events.venueName: Oud Maitha Theater, Zabeel Ladies Club
events.summary: URJA – Divine Energy is a three-day Indian classical music festival featuring Sikkil Gurucharan, Kunnakudi Balamuralikrishna and Bharat Sundar on successive nights. Platinumlist confirms the festival dates as 27–29 November 2026.
